title: Quantum security of Li's 2012, 2017, and 2019 near-optimal non-malleable extractors
summary: Determine whether the three near-optimal classical non-malleable extractors of Li cited by the source remain secure against quantum side information.

formal_statement.body: For each of Li's exact near-optimal constructions cited by the source as [5] (the 2012 Appendix B construction), [39] (the 2019 partially optimal construction), and [60] (the 2017 improved construction), prove the required non-malleability and output-uniformity trace-distance guarantee against every admissible quantum side-information state and seed tampering throughout that construction's entropy, seed-length, output-length, and error regime, or give a valid counterexample. Theorem 3 of the source proves a different one-output inner-product construction from Li [5], not the near-optimal Appendix B construction included here.

scope.domain: The exact near-optimal classical non-malleable extractor constructions cited as Li [5], Li [39], and Li [60]
assumptions: The source, seed, tampering function, and quantum side information satisfy the source's quantum non-malleable-extractor model
The statement concerns the original Li 2012 Appendix B, Li 2019, and Li 2017 constructions, not replacement constructions with different parameters
Source Theorem 3 concerns the distinct Definition 9 construction from Li [5] and does not settle Appendix B, Theorem B.4
scope.unresolved_remainder: All three exact instances [5], [39], and [60] remain unresolved. Inspected quantum-secure constructions use different extractor designs, and no theorem establishes the complete original security predicate for any instance.

citations.label: Aggarwal--Boddu--Jain--Obremski, Quantum Measurement Adversary
citations.locator: Section VI-C, Open Questions 1 and 3, journal p. 334

progress.summary: The source asks whether the cited near-optimal classical non-malleable extractors [5], [39], and [60] are quantum-secure; its Theorem 3 treats a different construction from the Li [5] paper.
